description: Source code defining utility classes for file handling, validation, and management within the Subtitle Sync Platform backend. Contains classes 'FileValidator' and 'FileManager' with methods for validating, saving, moving, cleanup, and retrieving info about files, primarily for video and subtitle files.

classes.name: FileValidator
classes.description: Provides static methods for validating file size, extension, and content for video and subtitle files.

classes.name: FileManager
classes.description: Provides methods to manage file storage including saving, moving, cleaning up temp files, and retrieving file info.

methods.name: bool validate_file_size(file_size: int)
methods.description: Checks if a file size is within the maximum allowed limit.

methods.name: bool validate_file_extension(filename: str, file_type: str)
methods.description: Checks if the file extension is within allowed types based on file type (video/subtitle).

methods.name: Dict[str,any] validate_file_content(file_path: str, expected_type: str)
methods.description: Uses mimetypes and content analysis to validate if a file matches expected type.

methods.name: bool _validate_subtitle_content(file_path: str)
methods.description: Checks initial content of subtitle files for common subtitle patterns.

methods.name: Dict[str,any] save_uploaded_file(self, file_obj: BinaryIO, filename: str, file_type: str)
methods.description: Saves an uploaded file after validation and computes checksum.

methods.name: str move_to_processed(self, source_path: str, new_filename: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Moves a file from upload to processed directory, handling filename conflicts.

methods.name: str create_temp_copy(self, source_path: str)
methods.description: Creates a temporary copy of a given file for processing.

methods.name: cleanup_temp_files(self, max_age_hours: int = 24)
methods.description: Removes temporary files older than a specified age.

methods.name: Dict[str,any] get_file_info(self, file_path: str)
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a file including size, MIME type, checksum, and timestamps.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,any]] list_files(self, directory: str, pattern: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Lists files in a directory with optional pattern filtering.

methods.name: str _generate_safe_filename(self, filename: str)
methods.description: Creates a sanitized filename that avoids problematic characters and adds timestamp.

methods.name: str _calculate_file_checksum(self, file_path: str)
methods.description: Calculates the MD5 checksum of a file for integrity validation.
